passages.text: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
This happened in the Wilderness of Sinai.
It was the first month of the second year after Israel left Egypt.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
He said, “The Israelites must observe the Passover.
They must do this at its appointed time.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה בְמִדְבַּר־ סִ֠ינַי בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הַשֵּׁנִ֜ית לְצֵאתָ֨ם מֵאֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵאמֹֽר׃ וְיַעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ הַפָּ֖סַח בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them to observe the Passover.
They must keep the Passover at its appointed time.
The appointed time is the fourteenth day of this month.
They must do it at twilight on that day.
They must follow all the Passover’s statutes.
They must obey all the Passover’s ordinances.
They must keep the Passover exactly as God commanded.
passages.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֣ה עָשָֽׂר־ י֠וֹם בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֜ה בֵּ֧ין הָֽעֲרְבַּ֛יִם תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּמוֹעֲד֑וֹ כְּכָל־ חֻקֹּתָ֥יו וּכְכָל־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover, and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD had given Moses commands for the people.
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He told them to observe the Passover.
The Israelites obeyed Moses.
They kept the Passover in the Wilderness of Sinai.
They did this at twilight.
They did it on the fourteenth day of the first month.
The Israelites followed all the LORD’s instructions.
They did everything the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת הַפָּֽסַח׃ וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֡סַח בָּרִאשׁ֡וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
passages.sermon:
Some men were unclean because they had touched a dead body.
They could not keep the Passover on that day.
These men came to Moses and Aaron on that same day.
They spoke to Moses.
They said, “We are unclean because of a dead body.
Why should we be kept from bringing the LORD’s offering at its appointed time with the other Israelites?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ טְמֵאִים֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם וְלֹא־ יָכְל֥וּ לַעֲשֹׂת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ וַ֠יֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָהֵ֙מָּה֙ אֵלָ֔יו אֲנַ֥חְנוּ טְמֵאִ֖ים לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה נִגָּרַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֨י הַקְרִ֜ב אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Some men came to Moses with a question about the Passover.
These men were unclean because of a dead body.
They could not keep the Passover at the appointed time.
Moses spoke to these men.
Moses said, “Wait here.”
Moses said, “I will listen to what the LORD commands for you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה עִמְד֣וּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָ֔ה מַה־ יְצַוֶּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לָכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “If any man among you is unclean because of a dead body, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
If any of your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
If any man among you is away on a distant journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
If any of your descendants is away on a distant journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ כִּי־ יִהְיֶֽה־ טָמֵ֣א׀ לָנֶ֡פֶשׁ אוֹ֩ בְדֶ֨רֶךְ רְחֹקָ֜הׄ לָכֶ֗ם א֚וֹ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָ֥שָׂה פֶ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs; they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to Moses for the Israelites about the Passover.
People who are unclean or on a journey may keep the Passover.
They must observe the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month.
They must do this at twilight.
They must eat the lamb with unleavened bread.
They must eat the lamb with bitter herbs.
They must not leave any of the lamb until morning.
They must not break any of the lamb’s bones.
They must keep the Passover according to all its rules.
passages.original: בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם יַעֲשׂ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ עַל־ מַצּ֥וֹת וּמְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃ לֹֽא־ יַשְׁאִ֤ירוּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עַד־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְעֶ֖צֶם לֹ֣א יִשְׁבְּרוּ־ ב֑וֹ כְּכָל־ חֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
passages.sermon:
A man may be ceremonially clean.
He may not be on a journey.
If this man does not observe the Passover, he disobeys God.
He does not present the LORD’s offering at the appointed time.
This man must be cut off from his people.
He will bear the consequences of his sin.
passages.original: וְהָאִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֨וּא טָה֜וֹר וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ הָיָ֗ה וְחָדַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔סַח וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּ֑יהָ כִּ֣י׀ קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֤א הִקְרִיב֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ חֶטְא֥וֹ יִשָּׂ֖א הָאִ֥ישׁ הַהֽוּא׃

passages.text: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A foreigner may live among you.
This foreigner may want to keep the Passover for the LORD.
He must follow the Passover rules.
He must obey the Passover laws.
You must use the same rule for everyone.
This rule is for the foreigner.
This rule is for the native of the land.
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ יָג֨וּר אִתְּכֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְעָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֙סַח֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כְּחֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֛סַח וּכְמִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר וּלְאֶזְרַ֥ח הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

passages.text: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites built the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was also called the Tent of the Testimony.
On the day they set up the tabernacle, a cloud covered it.
The cloud covered the tabernacle during the day.
In the evening, the cloud looked like fire above the tabernacle.
The fire-like appearance lasted until morning.
passages.original: וּבְיוֹם֙ הָקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן כִּסָּ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לְאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻ֑ת וּבָעֶ֜רֶב יִהְיֶ֧ה עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֖שׁ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
passages.sermon:
God led the Israelites in the wilderness.
God gave them the tabernacle as a holy place.
A cloud covered the tabernacle during the day.
The cloud stayed over the tabernacle all day.
At night, the cloud looked like fire.
This happened every day and every night.
The cloud and the fire showed God’s presence with His people.
passages.original: כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה תָמִ֔יד הֶעָנָ֖ן יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
passages.sermon:
God led the Israelites in the wilderness.
God used a cloud to show His presence.
The cloud stayed above the Tent of Meeting.
When the cloud lifted from the Tent, the Israelites set out.
When the cloud stopped and settled, the Israelites camped there.
The Israelites moved or camped according to the cloud.
passages.original: וּלְפִ֞י הֵעָלֹ֤ת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְאַ֣חֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבִמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכָּן־ שָׁם֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן שָׁ֥ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD’s command.
The LORD told them when to set out.
The LORD told them when to camp.
A cloud stayed over the tabernacle.
As long as the cloud stayed, the Israelites camped.
They did not move while the cloud remained.
passages.original: עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִסְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יַחֲנ֑וּ כָּל־ יְמֵ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכֹּ֧ן הֶעָנָ֛ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃

passages.text: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD’s command.
A cloud stayed over the tabernacle for many days.
The Israelites did not move.
They kept the LORD’s instructions.
They remained in their camp.
passages.original: וּבְהַאֲרִ֧יךְ הֶֽעָנָ֛ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְשָׁמְר֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD’s command.
The LORD gave instructions through the cloud.
Sometimes the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for only a few days.
When the cloud stayed, the Israelites camped.
When the LORD commanded, they set out.
They moved only when the LORD told them to move.
They camped only when the LORD told them to camp.
passages.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן יָמִ֥ים מִסְפָּ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַל־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD in the wilderness.
God gave them a sign.
A cloud rested over the tabernacle.
Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening until morning.
If the cloud lifted in the morning, the Israelites set out.
Sometimes the cloud lifted during the day or at night.
Whenever the cloud was taken up, the Israelites set out.
passages.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְנַעֲלָ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן בַּבֹּ֖קֶר וְנָסָ֑עוּ א֚וֹ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה וְנַעֲלָ֥ה הֶעָנָ֖ן וְנָסָֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD’s command in the wilderness.
A cloud from the LORD rested over the tabernacle.
Sometimes the cloud stayed for two days.
Sometimes the cloud stayed for a month.
Sometimes the cloud stayed for a longer time.
As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, the Israelites camped.
They did not set out while the cloud stayed.
When the cloud lifted from the tabernacle, the Israelites set out.
passages.original: אֽוֹ־ יֹמַ֜יִם אוֹ־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ אוֹ־ יָמִ֗ים בְּהַאֲרִ֨יךְ הֶעָנָ֤ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ לִשְׁכֹּ֣ן עָלָ֔יו יַחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְלֹ֣א יִסָּ֑עוּ וּבְהֵעָלֹת֖וֹ יִסָּֽעוּ׃

passages.text: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the LORD’s command.
They camped when the LORD told them to camp.
They set out when the LORD told them to set out.
They obeyed the LORD’s instructions.
Moses gave them the LORD’s instructions.
They did everything the LORD commanded through Moses.
passages.original: עַל־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּ֑עוּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת יְהוָה֙ שָׁמָ֔רוּ עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
